projection.growthBasis: Year-over-year growth from basedOnYear (2025) to currentYear (2026) reflects raised FY26 capex guidance announced during Q1 2026 hyperscaler earnings season. Aggregate Big-5 capex (Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta, Amazon, Oracle) of approximately USD 725 billion for 2026, the vast majority directed at AI compute, data centres, and networking. Sources: Bloomberg Intelligence, CreditSights, and Statista 2026-Q1 estimates. Historical entries reflect aggregate Big-5 hyperscaler capital expenditure as reported in 10-K filings, rounded to the nearest USD 5 billion.

source: Q1 2026 hyperscaler earnings — Bloomberg Intelligence, CreditSights, Statista compilation

categories.methodology: Aggregate US telecom-equipment capital investment 1996-2001 — approximately USD 500 billion in nominal dollars, financed largely with debt. The buildout that preceded the 2001 telecom bust.

aiBenefit.text: After the bust, only 2.7% of laid fibre was lit. The 'dark fibre' glut became the backbone of broadband, cloud, and video streaming for the next 20 years.

The Planetary Society — How much did the Apollo program cost?

categories.methodology: Total cumulative cost of the Apollo program (1961-1973), inflation-adjusted to 2024 USD: approximately USD 280 billion. Covers Mercury and Gemini predecessor programs, the Saturn V launch system, and all Apollo missions through Apollo 17.

aiBenefit.text: DeepMind's AlphaFold has predicted 214M+ protein structures, free for all researchers — solving a 50-year biology grand challenge.

Brookings Institution — The Costs of the Manhattan Project (Atomic Audit, Stephen I. Schwartz)

categories.methodology: Total cost of the Manhattan Project (1942-1946), USD 1.9 billion nominal, inflation-adjusted to approximately USD 30 billion in 2024 USD per Brookings' Atomic Audit (Schwartz, 1998).

aiBenefit.text: DeepMind's reinforcement-learning agent controlled superheated plasma inside a tokamak in real time — a step towards fusion energy.

Nature Food / IFPRI — Investment needs to end hunger by 2030

categories.methodology: Average additional annual public expenditure (approximately USD 33 billion) required from donors and low/middle-income governments through 2030 to end hunger (SDG 2), per Ceres2030 / IFPRI models published in Nature Food.

aiBenefit.text: The UN World Food Programme's HungerMap LIVE uses machine learning to predict food crises up to 60 days ahead, across 50+ countries.
